purpose: Determine named selected archive/compressed and extracted footprints and minimal usable file groups before deciding any model/data acquisition or real experiment. Total repository storage is not required task footprint.
allowed: Public HF metadata and strict HTTP Range reads of ZIP EOCD/ZIP64/central-directory only; no archive data-body/weights/tensors deserialization/extraction/model or environment install. If server ignores Range/returns200, close before reading body and mark unsupported.
checks: Bind HF revision/file size/LFS SHA metadata when available.
Validate HTTP206 and exact Content-Range; account actual bytes. Bounded reads and per-request timeouts.
Parse ZIP64 if needed; sum uncompressed/compressed entry sizes; count methods/encrypted/path anomalies. No extraction.
List checkpoint/config/normalization and dataset member groups needed for one PushT baseline; do not assert exact required set without planner loader source support.
Do not claim GPU/RAM feasibility from archive sizes alone. Report uncertainty and concrete next asset limit if sensible.
pair: existing actual Opus2 code/record review via manager
failure: No retry loop, no switching to full download if Range denied, preserve failure. At most original header plus one central directory request per archive apart from bounded ZIP64 record needs.
